Surv - Tailshaft Propeller Connection - Survey - Tail Shaft

ABS Record Only Comment : Reported by the owner's representative, trailing edge of propeller E blade was found bent afterward approx. 15 mm over an area of approx. 150 x 50 mm at the location of approx. 900 mm from blade tip.
The area was re-inspected during dry docking survey at this time, liquid penetrate test was carried out and no visual unacceptable indication was found, the repair is considered not necessary.
ABS Record Only Comment : Engine Power Limitation (EPL) approved, limiting the main engine’s power and speed to 32100kW and 88.8 rpm.
